As we complete more than a year of association with Tata 1mg at Tata Power, I would like to express my sincere appreciation for the Occupational Health Centre services provided by Tata 1mg Healthcare Solutions across Tata Power locations. The team consistently demonstrates dedication, remains readily available, and takes a proactive approach in their work. Their result-oriented mindset and high level of professionalism across all sites is truly commendable.

Chief Medical & Wellness Officer, TATA Power

Tata 1mg’s Annual Health Check-Up is truly a comprehensive check up , it offers approx. 67 tests that give a holistic overview and detailed insights on the body’s health. The process to book is extremely seamless and allows one to book it as per convenience. Their support and dedication in improving wellbeing and providing a well-rounded healthcare service is truly commendable.

Ronjaboti (HR team), EY India

I would like to extend our sincere thanks to Tata 1mg for successfully conducting health check-up camps at our various centers. The initiative was well planned, organized and professionally executed. Your medical team’s dedication, courteous approach towards pensioners at health checkup camps, ensured a smooth and comfortable experience to all the participants. The camps played a significant role in promoting health awareness and preventive care among pensioners, which is deeply appreciated.

DGM (Head Office), Canara Bank
